title: Benchmark Lot
description: v1 contract (task M5-T125, directive D-090 Wave 0, D-090-R002; derived lane plan docs/lanes/PARALLEL_BUILD_PLAN.md section 5) for a benchmark, pilot or golden lot: its identity; its expected values, EACH with its source and verification state; the recorded fixtures (repo path + SHA-256 of the file bytes) that back any 'recorded' value; which competitor-review checks C-1..C-12 apply (docs/COMPETITOR_REVIEW_ENVELOPE_215-16_NORTHERN_2026-09-28.md section D; plan docs/PRODUCT_PLAN_CURRENT_2026-09-28.md section 9a item 6); and the open items. Verification states: expected_unverified = stated by a document (competitor review, Zoning Resolution citation, public record) but not yet backed by recorded city data; recorded = backed by a recorded fixture cited by path and SHA-256; pending = claimed (e.g. by the plan) but not yet backed by any recorded fixture; pending_owner = waits on an owner decision; reviewed = signed by a qualified reviewer, which REQUIRES a review record (reviewer, date, record) - nothing is marked reviewed without one (D-090-R010; CLAUDE.md principle 12). A lot with unknown identity (a placeholder) carries no expected values and at least one open item.

contract_version.description: CLOSED enum of published benchmark_lot contract versions. 1.0.0 = M5-T125 initial shape (D-090 Wave 0). New versions are admitted only by an accepted contract task that appends to this enum.

purpose.description: benchmark = the checklist lot every check must pass on (plan section 9a item 6); pilot = Pilot A, one real single lot independently verified (section 11); multi_lot_pilot = Pilot B, multi-lot and condo behavior (section 11).

basis.description: Why this lot is in the set, citing the plan section or directive.

identity.description: Lot identity, or null while it is unknown (Pilot A before owner decision Q1).

expected_values.description: Expected values, each with its source and verification state. Keys use the same vocabulary as results answer values where one exists.

checks.description: Applicability of each competitor-review check C-1..C-12 (review section D), one entry per check. Each id is tied to its review title; uniqueness of ids is checked by consumers (the validator's keyword subset has no uniqueItems).

recorded_fixtures.description: Recorded files already in the repo that back 'recorded' values, each pinned by SHA-256 of its bytes.

reference_documents.description: Documents the expected values were taken from (e.g. the competitor review, the plan), each pinned by SHA-256 of its bytes.

open_items.description: Things still to verify or decide, in plain English.

_expected_failure.description: FIXTURE-ONLY annotation stating the intended defect of an invalid fixture (packages/contracts README convention). Producers NEVER emit this key.

oneOf.description: Placeholder: identity unknown, so no invented values and at least one open item.

bbls.description: The tax lots of the site (for a condominium: the base lots, not the billing lot).

billing_bbl.description: Condominium billing BBL when the property is a condominium; null otherwise.

identity_source.description: Where the identity is stated (directive, plan section, recorded fixture).

file_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of a file's committed bytes (LF line endings), the same convention as services/api/tests/fixtures/dtm_lot_outline/MANIFEST.json. Distinct from the canonical-json-1 'sha256:' digests in common.schema.json.

value.description: The expected value; null only when the value itself is not yet known (e.g. an unconfirmed street width).

review.description: Qualified-reviewer record; REQUIRED for 'reviewed' and null for every other state.

note.description: Plain-English note (e.g. 'about', or why a value must not be used a certain way).

source.description: The source of one expected value. 'ref' is the source exactly as the citing document gives it (e.g. 'ZR 23-22', 'Report p. 5; public records', 'ACRIS entries via PropertyShark'), or the repo path of a recorded fixture.

sha256.description: For recorded_fixture: SHA-256 of the fixture file's bytes; null otherwise.

pointer.description: For recorded_fixture: where in the file the value is (JSON path, property or constant name); null otherwise.

cited_in.description: The repo document (path and section) through which this source reached the benchmark, e.g. the competitor review section A; null when ref is itself the repo file.

quote.description: The citing document's own words for the value, verbatim; null when not applicable.

review.description: A qualified reviewer's sign-off (plan section 9a 'Reviewer (Q12)'; section 11 Pilot A golden record).

record_ref.description: The signed golden record or gate report.

applicability.description: applies = the check must pass on this lot; not_applicable = the check cannot arise here (reason required); pending = not yet decided (reason required).

pass_when.description: The review's 'Pass when' text, verbatim; null when not restated.

allOf.description: Each check id is tied to its title in the competitor review section D.
not_applicable and pending need a reason.

dataset.description: Source dataset of the recorded content (e.g. 'nyc-dof-digital-tax-map', 'p8u6-a6it (DOF DTM Condominiums)').

retrieved_at.description: When the recorded content was retrieved: a timestamp, a date when only the date is recorded, or null when the file records none itself.
